business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

claimed_weeks_late.description: Weeks late the customer counted in the claim.

controlled_item_or_record.description: Immutable item, lot set, or transaction record in scope.

credit_cap_usd.description: Cap on credits for one escalation per billing period (cap percentage of the monthly fee).

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

excluded_quantity.description: voided and other-escalation credits on the ledger

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for the customer's accounts-payable confirmation CV-AP-51190 of standard and off-cycle application dates.

ld_per_week_usd.description: Weekly liquidated-damages amount from the commitment register.

monthly_fee_usd.description: Monthly fee on the active agreement that the cap is applied to.

observed_quantity.description: Gross observed quantity before applying the control for the Corvane meter-data connector settlement.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit of measure for every controlled quantity: USD.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented credit cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing issue_supported_ld_standard_run, pay_five_week_claim_off_cycle, substitute_extended_support_for_ld.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

source_quantity.description: USD of liquidated damages for the accepted-late meter-data connector under clause 11.2 of AGR-7781

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for the customer's accounts-payable confirmation CV-AP-51190 of standard and off-cycle application dates.

supported_quantity.description: credits on the AGR-7781 ledger that offset ESC-3142

supported_weeks_late.description: Whole weeks from the committed date to the accepted delivery date on the certificate.

transaction_quantity.description: Exact quantity the primary state change may persist.

unsupported_claim_usd.description: Portion of the claim the contract does not support (claimed amount minus entitlement).

facts.rubric: Located ESC-3142 using immutable identifiers and preserved effective revision v1: customer CUST-2253 (Corvane Energy) resolves to open claim escalation ESC-3142 on ticket TCK-88490 and commitment CMT-4460; ESC-3099 is the closed February escalation with its own credit.

facts.rubric: Applied the escalation record and the v5 standard to establish 4500 USD for USD of liquidated damages for the accepted-late meter-data connector under clause 11.2 of AGR-7781, with control date 2026-05-08.
facts.statement: The effective escalation record and the v5 standard establish USD of liquidated damages for the accepted-late meter-data connector under clause 11.2 of AGR-7781 = 4500 USD: the certificate dates the acceptance 2026-04-10, three whole weeks after the 2026-03-20 committed date, so clause 11.2 yields 3 × USD 1,500 = USD 4,500 under the USD 6,750 cap. The control date is 2026-05-08 (clause 11.4 applies the settlement within 30 days of the 2026-04-10 acceptance (CMT-4461)).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 4700 observed less 3700 excluded to 1000 supported USD for credits on the AGR-7781 ledger that offset ESC-3142.
facts.statement: the gross ledger holds USD 4,700; CR-9203 (2,700) belongs to ESC-3099 and CR-9260 (1,000) is voided, so only the pending CR-9244 (1,000) offsets and USD 3,500 remains owed; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a header total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-05-04 standard and 2026-04-23 expedited readiness inputs from the customer's accounts-payable confirmation CV-AP-51190 of standard and off-cycle application dates, then separately derived each alternative's operating outcome under the liquidated-damages schedule, the agreement cap, and the ledger offset rule instead of treating a counterparty promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: the customer's accounts-payable confirmation CV-AP-51190 of standard and off-cycle application dates: the customer's accounts-payable confirmation CV-AP-51190 gives the 2026-05-01 invoice run (reflected 2026-05-04) and an off-cycle note on 2026-04-22 (reflected 2026-04-23, +USD 120); a counterparty confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied the billing-run calendar and its credit-memo cut-off to derive the three option outcomes without displacing protected blocks or committed dates.
facts.statement: the billing-run calendar and its credit-memo cut-off: the billing-run calendar's May run is 2026-05-01 with a 2026-04-24 credit-memo cut-off; a memo raised now makes the run; protected and leave blocks cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-WP-0105 only to issue_supported_ld_standard_run and ESC-3142; kept pay_five_week_claim_off_cycle outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-WP-0105 covers one liquidated-damages credit memo up to USD 5,000 on the standard run only; the five-week count and anything above the cap need the finance controller, and a support-days substitute needs the support director. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize pay_five_week_claim_off_cycle.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected issue_supported_ld_standard_run: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies the liquidated-damages schedule, the agreement cap, and the ledger offset rule.
facts.statement: clause 11.4 requires the settlement applied within 30 days of the 2026-04-10 acceptance, so the credit must be reflected by 2026-05-08; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside the liquidated-damages schedule, the agreement cap, and the ledger offset rule.

options.consequence: issue supported LD standard run submits the USD 3,500 net liquidated damages (three whole weeks at USD 1,500 less the USD 1,000 goodwill pending) on the 2026-05-01 invoice run, reflected 2026-05-04, four days inside the settlement deadline, within AP-WP-0105.
options.label: issue_supported_ld_standard_run: outcome 2026-05-04, incremental cost USD 3500, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: pay five-week claim off cycle would credit the customer's USD 7,500 count less the 1,000 pending (USD 6,500 plus the 120 recharge) on 2026-04-23, but it exceeds the USD 6,750 cap and the account director's limit and needs the finance controller.
options.label: pay_five_week_claim_off_cycle: outcome 2026-04-23, incremental cost USD 6620, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

options.consequence: substitute extended support for LD would offer a support extension from 2026-04-17 instead of a credit, but clause 11.2 makes liquidated damages the remedy for an accepted late delivery, so the contract does not support it.
options.label: substitute_extended_support_for_ld: outcome 2026-04-17, incremental cost USD 0, FAILS_CURRENT_CONTROL

title: Settle the Corvane liquidated-damages claim for the late connector

interaction_contract.investigation_evidence: Retrieve the applicable source records, policy, approval, and evidence through the connected provider tools before the first state change. The tool CLI, MCP, REST, and web tool forms share one audited trace. Reading /workspace/evidence directly is a convenience, but filesystem reads are not recorded and do not satisfy required tool investigations.
interaction_contract.stakeholder_draft: Leave an unsent draft for the requested recipient. Its body must name the persisted primary record and supported outcome date; research drafts must also identify the current definition. Preserve the business reference and explain the decision and constraints. An internal option identifier is required only in the structured answer, not in prose.
interaction_contract.text_matching: Required text facts use case-insensitive, punctuation-normalized whole tokens. Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD. These are structural checks, not a semantic assessment of arbitrary prose or contradictions.
